sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: This case defines the limits of government-sponsored religious speech. It determines whether local boards can open meetings with sectarian prayers. The outcome shapes the daily experience of citizens attending public meetings. It clarifies the boundary between state and religion in local governance.
